newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican business leaders oppose tax hikes.
newsitem.headline: Mexican business leaders oppose tax hikes.

text.p: The Monterrey National Chamber of Commerce (Canaco) on Tuesday came out against possible tax hikes during the next fiscal year.
"We will not accept any increases in taxes, or in wages," Canaco president Jose Mario Garza Benavides told reporters.
"Over the last ten years, it has been business and workers that have made the sacrifices," he said.
Garza said that the Monterrey Canaco will make proposals for the national Confederation of Chambers of Commerce in order to defend its stance with the government.
The proposals include tax breaks on fixed assets for businesses, Garza said.

Workers would meanwhile need to have tax breaks extended from four times to ten times the minimum wage in order to offset losses in purchasing power, which Garza estimated at 28 percent over the past 21 months.
